Among these, PGS004236 is best supported by a strong, directly aligned endpoint (prevalent hypertension), multi-ethnic design with explicit multi-ancestry development and evaluation, and comparatively strong full-model discrimination evidence (AUROC=0.764 with reported OR=2.1). Competing candidates either come from pan-trait/framework families (e.g., PGS001320 from the ‘813 traits’ framework; PGS001838/PGS002047 from the ‘Portability of 245’ framework), have lower/less informative metrics (e.g., PGS000706 AUROC=0.623; PGS002777/PGS002778 AUROC~0.56), or are single-ancestry-only evaluations without clear PRS-only metrics. {"outcome":"DIRECT_HIGH_QUALITY","best_model_id":"PGS001320","confidence":"Moderate","rationale":"Direct-match hypertension candidates are present (e.g., PGS000706, PGS001320, PGS001838, PGS002047, PGS002296, PGS002335, PGS002994–PGS003028, PGS004191–PGS004194, PGS004234, PGS004236, PGS004785–PGS004788, PGS004934, PGS004455, PGS004525, etc.). Competing direct-match models either lack PRS-only metrics (many report only full-model AUROC or partial-r), are from framework/portability repositories with weaker comparability signals (e.g., ExPRSweb entries), or focus on prevalent hypertension without PRS-only metrics despite higher full-model AUROC (e.g., PGS004234/PGS004236). {"outcome":"DIRECT_HIGH_QUALITY","best_model_id":"PGS001320","confidence":"High","rationale":"Multiple direct-match hypertension PRS are present (e.g., PGS000706, PGS001320, PGS001838, PGS002047, PGS002335, PGS002652, PGS002701, PGS004191-4, PGS004234, PGS004236, PGS004455/4525, PGS004934, PGS005144/5153). Among candidates with clear endpoint alignment to generic hypertension (trait_efo and phenotyping_reported both 'Hypertension'), PGS001320 provides the strongest PRS-comparable performance evidence: it reports explicit PGS-only metrics (PGS AUROC (no covariates)=0.62908; PGS R2 (no covariates)=0.06493) plus incremental AUROC=0.04424, with basic covariates (age, sex, array type, genotype PCs) and large UKB development/validation (n=269,704 training; n=67,425 validation; multi-ancestry evaluation mix). Main limitation: PGS001320 comes from a pan-trait sparse-PRS framework paper (PLoS Genet '813 traits'), which domain knowledge flags as often underperforming disease-focused scores; however, within the visible evidence set it remains the best-supported because it uniquely offers strong endpoint fidelity plus explicit PRS-only and incremental metrics for hypertension without heavy clinical covariates."}

{"outcome":"DIRECT_HIGH_QUALITY","best_model_id":"PGS004236","confidence":"Moderate","rationale":"Multiple direct-match hypertension PRS candidates are present (e.g., PGS000706, PGS001320, PGS001838, PGS002047, PGS002335, PGS004234, PGS004236, PGS004934). Main limitation: PGS004236’s performance is reported as full-model AUROC (not PRS-only AUROC/R2), and the endpoint is prevalent hypertension; thus standalone PRS contribution and incident-risk performance are not directly established from the visible metrics, lowering confidence from High to Moderate."}

{"outcome":"DIRECT_HIGH_QUALITY","best_model_id":"PGS000004","confidence":"Moderate","rationale":"Multiple direct-match models are present for breast carcinoma (e.g., PGS000001/004/007/015/028/029/050/072/332/335/336/242/688/869 and many others).
